ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Encounter records turn the ordinary evidentiary rebuke back on visitors who trust a name before meeting the person in front of them.
EvidenceBody: Visitors who arrive trusting reputation are confronted with the person before their eyes and accused of valuing hearing over sight.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The rendering retains prizing the ear and belittling the eye, the relation repeated in the reviewed cases.

ModifierControls.Term: prizing the ear and belittling the eye
ModifierControls.Finding: One sensory judgment alone loses the phrase’s explicit reversal of evidentiary value.

FamilyControls.Finding: Cases about reputation or direct sight count only when hearing is prized and seeing belittled.
